'''2012 Yavin 4 Regionals Tom Haid LS Watch Your Step (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Tom Haid]] at [[2012 Yavin 4 Regionals]] (Regionals).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Watch Your Step (V) / This Place Can Be A Little Rough (V)]]
* '''Username:''' Xanth
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Regionals
